misconception_label: Thinks a bigger denominator means a bigger fraction
title: Ordering And Comparing Fractions — worked example

body.title: Ordering And Comparing Fractions — worked example
body.hook: We'll learn ordering and comparing fractions by studying one clear example first.

steps: Read the problem: Which is larger: 1/3 or 1/4?
Same numerator: smaller denominator means larger pieces.
Watch out: Thinks a bigger denominator means a bigger fraction

body.misconception_check: Avoid this trap: Thinks a bigger denominator means a bigger fraction

exit_ticket.prompt: Which fraction is closest to 1: 3/4, 2/3, or 1/2?

practice.prompt: True or false: 2/6 is greater than 2/4.
Which fraction is closest to 1: 3/4, 2/3, or 1/2?
True or false: 2/6 is greater than 2/4.
Which fraction is closest to 1: 3/4, 2/3, or 1/2?
